description: Flatland railway environment provides the Flatland environment for developing and comparing multi-agent reinforcement-learning algorithms in railway-like grid worlds. The provider is Flatland Association. Geographical and temporal coverage: The project documents multiple challenges from 2021 to 2026 and tests Python 3.10 through 3.14. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Grid-world resource-allocation environments abstract real railway infrastructure. They are benchmarks, not calibrated operational networks. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
